description: The CLI features the Go CLI does not have (internal docs/design/go-cli.md, decision 3), for --cli go:<path>: a check that needs one reports client-lacks, from the runner (lib/client-lacks.mjs). The pull request that builds a feature removes its entry; a lacking check that passes fails the run as stale.
